tolerances.acceptance_rule: Every numeric field must satisfy both max_abs and RMS limits over one step and the entire short rollout in both scenarios; every exact/mask/action-conversion limit must also pass. Thresholds are inherited unchanged from v2 and must not be changed after this measurement.

scenarios.determinism: The startup-DR patch is sampled from the fixed DR seed. Two fixed validation-only velocity deltas are applied after zero-based control steps 39 and 99 in both source and replay.
scenarios.name: deterministic_nontrivial_dr
